items.title: In your inbox: the EDPS Newsletter is out!
items.description: In your inbox: the EDPS Newsletter is out! The latest edition is out. Inside: 🏛️ What can lessons from Aristotle to Ubuntu tell us about what AI should do? Our new collaboration with Oxford's Institute for Ethics in AI brings philosophy into AI policy. 🧒 Protecting children online need not mean locking them out. Our Opinion on the EU KIDS Act. 🏆 At the Global Privacy Assembly: an award for the EDPS and a new Practice Hub for authorities. 🌐 How EU data exchange with Interpol should guard against misuse of the system. ➕ Register for Data Protection Day 2027, six tech trends to watch, and more. Read the full edition here: https:// link.europa.eu/q97yYD And remember to subscribe: https:// link.europa.eu/QRQkwd
